# Instructions Directory

Domain-specific instructions for AI assistants and contributors.

## Files

- `frontend.instructions.md` — React/TypeScript/Vite UI implementation guidance.
- `backend.instructions.md` — Integration and service-layer guidance.
- `docs.instructions.md` — Documentation authoring and maintenance standards.
- `bdd-tests.instructions.md` — Testing strategy and BDD expectations.

## Authoring rules

- Keep each file single-purpose.
- Reference SSOT documents instead of duplicating long policies.
- Use concise, actionable rules with examples where useful.
